Big Yellow Keeps Options Under Review as Investor Pushes for Sale
Big Yellow Group said it continues to evaluate all options to maximize shareholder value after private-equity company Ancora urged the U.K. self-storage company to put itself up for sale.
The company on Thursday confirmed it recently met with a shareholder that is encouraging it to explore a sale.
Ancora, which has more than 4% stake in Big Yellow, said Tuesday that it plans to engage constructively with the company to deliver better value for shareholders.
The activist investor urged Big Yellow's board to launch a strategic review, including a sale process. It said a sale would represent the best risk-adjusted outcome for shareholders.
Big Yellow said Thursday that it received a takeover approach in December 2025, but terminated discussions as the valuation "was not at a level that reflected the full potential of the company".

"The board and management team continue to focus on executing the company's clear and proven strategy," Big Yellow said, adding that it continues to evaluate options to maximize value as part of its fiduciary duties.
